note: Animal voices (SND-003): cmd/sfxgen sends each prompt (+ defaults.suffix) to ElevenLabs text-to-sound-effects. Ids are animal.<roster key>.<call|attack|hurt|die>, the 9 voice groups animal.<group>.<event>, and animal.burst (animal.generic.* stays a procedural placeholder). Our own words: describe the creature, never RimWorld names. Budget and spending rules: prompts.json and SND-003.

defaults.suffix: , close-up, dry, no music, no background noise, no human voice
